verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע בֶּן־ שָׁא֗וּל כִּ֣י מֵ֤ת אַבְנֵר֙ בְּחֶבְר֔וֹן וַיִּרְפּ֖וּ יָדָ֑יו וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נִבְהָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ben- šā·’ūl kî mêṯ ’aḇ·nêr bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn way·yir·pū yā·ḏāw wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl niḇ·hā·lū
verses.literal: Now when Ish-bosheth son of Saul heard that Abner had died in Hebron he lost courage and all Israel was dismayed
verses.literalPt: OUVINDO, pois, o filho de Saul, que Abner morrera em Hebrom, as mãos se lhe afrouxaram; e todo o Israel pasmou.

verses.original: וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲנָשִׁ֣ים שָׂרֵֽי־ גְדוּדִ֣ים הָי֪וּ בֶן־ שָׁא֟וּל שֵׁם֩ הָאֶחָ֨ד בַּֽעֲנָ֜ה וְשֵׁ֧ם הַשֵּׁנִ֣י רֵכָ֗ב בְּנֵ֛י רִמּ֥וֹן הַבְּאֶֽרֹתִ֖י מִבְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן כִּ֚י גַּם־ בְּאֵר֔וֹת תֵּחָשֵׁ֖ב עַל־ בִּנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·nê ’ă·nā·šîm śā·rê- ḡə·ḏū·ḏîm hā·yū ḇen- šā·’ūl šêm hā·’e·ḥāḏ ba·‘ă·nāh wə·šêm haš·šê·nî rê·ḵāḇ bə·nê rim·mō·wn hab·bə·’e·rō·ṯî mib·bə·nê ḇin·yā·min kî gam- bə·’ê·rō·wṯ tê·ḥā·šêḇ ‘al- bin·yā·min
verses.literal: Saul’s son had two men who were leaders of raiding parties . . . One was named Baanah . . . and the other Rechab they were sons of Rimmon the Beerothite of the tribe of Benjamin . . . Beeroth is considered part of Benjamin
verses.literalPt: E tinha o filho de Saul dois homens capitães de tropas; e era o nome de um Baaná, e o nome do outro Recabe, filhos de Rimom, o beerotita, dos filhos de Benjamim, porque também Beerote se reputava de Benjamim.

verses.original: וַיִּבְרְח֥וּ הַבְּאֵרֹתִ֖ים גִּתָּ֑יְמָה וַֽיִּהְיוּ־ שָׁ֣ם גָּרִ֔ים עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·rə·ḥū hab·bə·’ê·rō·ṯîm git·tā·yə·māh way·yih·yū- šām gā·rîm ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: because the Beerothites fled to Gittaim and have lived there as foreigners to this day
verses.literalPt: E tinham fugido os beerotitas para Gitaim, e ali têm peregrinado até ao dia de hoje.

verses.original: וְלִיהֽוֹנָתָן֙ בֶּן־ שָׁא֔וּל בֵּ֖ן נְכֵ֣ה רַגְלָ֑יִם בֶּן־ חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֣ים הָיָ֡ה בְּבֹ֣א שְׁמֻעַת֩ שָׁא֨וּל וִיהֽוֹנָתָ֜ן מִֽיִּזְרְעֶ֗אל וַתִּשָּׂאֵ֤הוּ אֹֽמַנְתּוֹ֙ וַתָּנֹ֔ס וַיְהִ֞י בְּחָפְזָ֥הּ לָנ֛וּס וַיִּפֹּ֥ל וַיִּפָּסֵ֖חַ וּשְׁמ֥וֹ מְפִיבֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lî·hō·w·nā·ṯān ben- šā·’ūl bên nə·ḵêh raḡ·lā·yim ben- ḥā·mêš šā·nîm hā·yāh bə·ḇō šə·mu·‘aṯ šā·’ūl wî·hō·w·nā·ṯān mî·yiz·rə·‘el wat·tiś·śā·’ê·hū ’ō·man·tōw wat·tā·nōs way·hî bə·ḥā·p̄ə·zāh lā·nūs way·yip·pōl way·yip·pā·sê·aḥ ū·šə·mōw mə·p̄î·ḇō·šeṯ
verses.literal: And Jonathan son of Saul had a son who was lame in his feet He was five years old . . . when the report about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel His nurse picked him up and fled . . . but as she was hurrying to escape he fell and became lame His name was Mephibosheth
verses.literalPt: E Jônatas, filho de Saul, tinha um filho aleijado de ambos os pés; era da idade de cinco anos quando as novas de Saul e Jônatas vieram de Jizreel, e sua ama o tomou, e fugiu; e sucedeu que, apressando-se ela a fugir, ele caiu, e ficou coxo; e o seu nome era Mefibosete.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ בְּנֵֽי־ רִמּ֤וֹן הַבְּאֵֽרֹתִי֙ רֵכָ֣ב וּבַעֲנָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ כְּחֹ֣ם הַיּ֔וֹם אֶל־ בֵּ֖ית אִ֣ישׁ בֹּ֑שֶׁת וְה֣וּא שֹׁכֵ֔ב אֵ֖ת מִשְׁכַּ֥ב הַֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū bə·nê- rim·mō·wn hab·bə·’ê·rō·ṯî rê·ḵāḇ ū·ḇa·‘ă·nāh way·yā·ḇō·’ū kə·ḥōm hay·yō·wm ’el- bêṯ ’îš bō·šeṯ wə·hū šō·ḵêḇ ’êṯ miš·kaḇ haṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim
verses.literal: Now Rechab and Baanah the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite set out and arrived at the house of Ish-bosheth in the heat of the day while the king was taking his midday nap
verses.literalPt: E foram os filhos de Rimom, o beerotita, Recabe e Baaná, e entraram em casa de Is-Bosete no maior calor do dia, estando ele deitado a dormir, ao meio dia.

verses.original: וְ֠הֵנָּה בָּ֜אוּ עַד־ תּ֤וֹךְ הַבַּ֙יִת֙ לֹקְחֵ֣י חִטִּ֔ים וַיַּכֻּ֖הוּ אֶל־ הַחֹ֑מֶשׁ וְרֵכָ֛ב וּבַעֲנָ֥ה אָחִ֖יו נִמְלָֽטוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hên·nāh bā·’ū ‘aḏ- tō·wḵ hab·ba·yiṯ lō·qə·ḥê ḥiṭ·ṭîm way·yak·ku·hū ’el- ha·ḥō·meš wə·rê·ḵāḇ ū·ḇa·‘ă·nāh ’ā·ḥîw nim·lā·ṭū
verses.literal: They entered . . . the interior of the house as if to get some wheat and they stabbed him in the stomach Then Rechab and his brother Baanah slipped away
verses.literalPt: E ali entraram até ao meio da casa, como que vindo buscar trigo, e o feriram na quinta costela; e Recabe e Baaná, seu irmão, escaparam.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ הַבַּ֗יִת וְהֽוּא־ שֹׁכֵ֤ב עַל־ מִטָּתוֹ֙ בַּחֲדַ֣ר מִשְׁכָּב֔וֹ וַיַּכֻּ֙הוּ֙ וַיְמִתֻ֔הוּ וַיָּסִ֖ירוּ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וַיֵּֽלְכ֛וּ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הָעֲרָבָ֖ה כָּל־ הַלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū hab·ba·yiṯ wə·hū- šō·ḵêḇ ‘al- miṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ba·ḥă·ḏar miš·kā·ḇōw way·yak·ku·hū way·mi·ṯu·hū way·yā·sî·rū ’eṯ- rō·šōw way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- rō·šōw way·yê·lə·ḵū de·reḵ hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh kāl- hal·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: They had entered the house while Ish-bosheth was lying on his bed . . . . . . and having stabbed and killed him they beheaded him took his head and traveled all night by way of the Arabah
verses.literalPt: Porque entraram na sua casa, estando ele na cama deitado, no seu quarto, e o feriram, e o mataram, e lhe cortaram a cabeça; e, tomando a sua cabeça, andaram toda a noite caminhando pela planície.

verses.original: וַ֠יָּבִאוּ אֶת־ רֹ֨אשׁ אִֽישׁ־ בֹּ֥שֶׁת אֶל־ דָּוִד֮ חֶבְרוֹן֒ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הִנֵּֽה־ רֹ֣אשׁ אִֽישׁ־ בֹּ֗שֶׁת בֶּן־ שָׁאוּל֙ אֹֽיִבְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּקֵּ֖שׁ אֶת־ נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וַיִּתֵּ֣ן יְ֠הוָה לַֽאדֹנִ֨י הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ נְקָמוֹת֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה מִשָּׁא֖וּל וּמִזַּרְעֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇi·’ū ’eṯ- rōš ’îš- bō·šeṯ ’el- dā·wiḏ ḥeḇ·rō·wn way·yō·mə·rū ’el- ham·me·leḵ hin·nêh- rōš ’îš- bō·šeṯ ben- šā·’ūl ’ō·yiḇ·ḵā ’ă·šer biq·qêš ’eṯ- nap̄·še·ḵā way·yit·tên Yah·weh la·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ nə·qā·mō·wṯ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh miš·šā·’ūl ū·miz·zar·‘ōw
verses.literal: They brought the head of Ish-bosheth to David at Hebron and said to the king Here is the head of Ish-bosheth son of Saul your enemy who sought your life Today . . . the LORD has granted vengeance to my lord the king against Saul and his offspring
verses.literalPt: E trouxeram a cabeça de Is-Bosete a Davi, a Hebrom, e disseram ao rei: Eis aqui a cabeça de Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, teu inimigo, que procurava a tua morte; assim o SENHOR vingou hoje ao rei meu senhor, de Saul e da sua descendência.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן דָּוִ֜ד אֶת־ רֵכָ֣ב׀ וְאֶת־ בַּעֲנָ֣ה אָחִ֗יו בְּנֵ֛י רִמּ֥וֹן הַבְּאֵֽרֹתִ֖י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֑ם חַי־ יְהוָ֕ה אֲשֶׁר־ פָּדָ֥ה אֶת־ נַפְשִׁ֖י מִכָּל־ צָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- rê·ḵāḇ wə·’eṯ- ba·‘ă·nāh ’ā·ḥîw bə·nê rim·mō·wn hab·bə·’ê·rō·ṯî way·yō·mer lā·hem ḥay- Yah·weh ’ă·šer- pā·ḏāh ’eṯ- nap̄·šî mik·kāl ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: But David answered Rechab and his brother Baanah the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite - As surely as the LORD lives who has redeemed my life from all distress
verses.literalPt: Porém Davi, respondendo a Recabe e a Baaná, seu irmão, filhos de Rimom, o beerotita, disse-lhes: Vive o SENHOR, que remiu a minha alma de toda a angústia,

verses.original: כִּ֣י הַמַּגִּיד֩ לִ֨י לֵאמֹ֜ר הִנֵּה־ מֵ֣ת שָׁא֗וּל וְהֽוּא־ הָיָ֤ה כִמְבַשֵּׂר֙ בְּעֵינָ֔יו וָאֹחֲזָ֣ה ב֔וֹ וָאֶהְרְגֵ֖הוּ בְּצִֽקְלָ֑ג אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְתִתִּי־ ל֖וֹ בְּשֹׂרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ham·mag·gîḏ lî lê·mōr hin·nêh- mêṯ šā·’ūl wə·hū- hā·yāh ḵim·ḇaś·śêr bə·‘ê·nāw wā·’ō·ḥă·zāh ḇōw wā·’eh·rə·ḡê·hū bə·ṣiq·lāḡ ’ă·šer lə·ṯit·tî- lōw bə·śō·rāh
verses.literal: when someone told me . . . Look Saul is dead and thought he was a bearer of good news I seized him and put him to death at Ziklag That was his reward for his news
verses.literalPt: Se aquele que me trouxe novas, dizendo: Eis que Saul é morto, parecendo-lhe, porém, aos olhos que era como quem trazia boas novas, eu logo lancei mão dele, e o matei em Ziclague, cuidando ele que eu por isso lhe desse recompensa.

verses.original: אַ֞ף כִּֽי־ אֲנָשִׁ֣ים רְשָׁעִ֗ים הָרְג֧וּ אֶת־ אִישׁ־ צַדִּ֛יק בְּבֵית֖וֹ עַל־ מִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ וְעַתָּ֗ה הֲל֨וֹא אֲבַקֵּ֤שׁ אֶת־ דָּמוֹ֙ מִיֶּדְכֶ֔ם וּבִעַרְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ kî- ’ă·nā·šîm rə·šā·‘îm hā·rə·ḡū ’eṯ- ’îš- ṣad·dîq bə·ḇê·ṯōw ‘al- miš·kā·ḇōw wə·‘at·tāh hă·lō·w ’ă·ḇaq·qêš ’eṯ- dā·mōw mî·yeḏ·ḵem ū·ḇi·‘ar·tî ’eṯ·ḵem min- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: How much more when wicked men kill a righteous man in his own house and on his own bed shall I not now . . . require his blood from your hands and remove you from the earth
verses.literalPt: Quanto mais a ímpios homens, que mataram um homem justo em sua casa, sobre a sua cama; agora, pois, não requereria eu o seu sangue de vossas mãos, e não vos exterminaria da terra?

verses.original: וַיְצַו֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶת־ הַנְּעָרִ֜ים וַיַּהַרְג֗וּם וַֽיְקַצְּצ֤וּ אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶם֙ וְאֶת־ רַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּתְל֥וּ עַל־ הַבְּרֵכָ֖ה בְּחֶבְר֑וֹן וְאֵ֨ת רֹ֤אשׁ אִֽישׁ־ בֹּ֙שֶׁת֙ לָקָ֔חוּ וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ בְקֶֽבֶר־ אַבְנֵ֖ר בְּחֶבְרֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- han·nə·‘ā·rîm way·ya·har·ḡūm way·qaṣ·ṣə·ṣū ’eṯ- yə·ḏê·hem wə·’eṯ- raḡ·lê·hem way·yiṯ·lū ‘al- hab·bə·rê·ḵāh bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn wə·’êṯ rōš ’îš- bō·šeṯ lā·qā·ḥū way·yiq·bə·rū ḇə·qe·ḇer- ’aḇ·nêr bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn
verses.literal: So David commanded his young men and they killed Rechab and Baanah They cut off their hands and feet and hung their bodies by the pool in Hebron but they took the head of Ish-bosheth and buried it in Abner’s tomb in Hebron
verses.literalPt: E deu Davi ordem aos seus moços que os matassem; e cortaram-lhes os pés e as mãos, e os penduraram sobre o tanque de Hebrom; tomaram, porém, a cabeça de Is-Bosete, e a sepultaram na sepultura de Abner, em Hebrom.
